Photo 0 shows no power-on, stitching test, or sound/operation proof.

risks.risk: Whether it actually stitches smoothly (timing, feed, tension) and runs without unusual noise or skipping.
risks.proof: Short video of power-on and a real stitching test on fabric (straight seam + turning corner) showing the feed moving consistently.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (needle, bobbin, bobbin case, presser feet, foot pedal, power cable) or incomplete setup.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included parts laid out (needle, bobbin/bobbin case, presser feet, pedal, power cable) and a close-up of the needle/bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly incomplete (worst case: buyer must replace missing parts).

risks.risk: Electrical/motor/drive issues (motor weak, belt/drive problem, pedal not functioning).
risks.proof: Video showing the motor running and pedal response (speed changes) with the machine moving the needle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require electrical/drive repair.

risks.risk: Model/industrial spec mismatch affecting parts availability and repair cost.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model plate/serial number label (usually on the side/back) and close-up of the machine head label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without model certainty (worst case: harder/expensive parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the model plate/serial number label (side/back of the machine head).
Send a short video: power-on + pedal speed control + stitching test on fabric.
List and show included accessories (needle, bobbin/bobbin case, presser feet, pedal, power cable).
response.reason: The photo identifies a FLY sewing machine, but there is no proof it is working perfectly or that it is complete. To price safely in Oyo, you need a stitching test and model/serial close-up.
